scripts.build: bun --cwd packages/api build && bun --cwd packages/web build
scripts.lint: bun --cwd packages/api lint && bun --cwd packages/web lint
scripts.lint:fix: bun --cwd packages/api lint:fix && bun --cwd packages/web lint:fix
scripts.check: bun --cwd packages/api check && bun --cwd packages/web check
scripts.format: bun --cwd packages/api format && bun --cwd packages/web format
scripts.test: bun --cwd packages/api test && bun --cwd packages/web test
scripts.test:all: bun --cwd packages/api test && bun --cwd packages/api test:integration && bun --cwd packages/web test
scripts.verify: bun run lint && bun run check && bun run typecheck && bun run test:all
scripts.playwright:install: cd packages/web && bunx playwright install --with-deps chromium
scripts.clean: rm -rf node_modules packages/*/node_modules packages/*/.next packages/*/build packages/*/dist
